directive: Use BUSINESS.md as the draft EIR soul, but do not treat the project as roadmap-adopted until operator merge and validation gates clear.
one_liner: Built CivicState civic-letter app; investibility waits on demand, delivery, citations, and operator ruling.

authority.adoption: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption — operator ruling 2026-06-12 [evidence: dispatch instruction]; see the PR's POM record

methods: Read planning docs, package metadata, Prisma schema, API routes, worker agents, app page, and dispatch registry note.
Inspected existing gate paths before creating this native wrk business-plan gate.
Tagged external market and competitor claims as assumptions.
limitations: No production analytics, Stripe exports, Postmark deliverability reports, user interviews, or legal review artifacts were found.
Factory or prior AI planning output is repo evidence of intent/build history, not external market proof.
Competitor and market details require network refresh before investor-facing use.

planningMethod.honestyRule: Every quantitative claim in BUSINESS.md is labeled [evidence] or [assumption: basis].

customer.primary: United States resident with a concrete civic issue who would contact government if research, official targeting, drafting, and delivery were handled [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md].
customer.excluded: Legal claimants, regulatory filers, business-entity advocacy buyers, bulk campaign operators, harassment targets, and users trying to send threats or defamatory allegations [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md and moderation/compliance design].
customer.unproven: Willingness to pay $5-$25 is unvalidated [assumption: no customer artifact found].

market.method: Bottom-up wedge model, not sourced TAM.
market.localWedge: 240 annual paid submissions and $3,360 annual gross revenue [assumption: 10 niches times 100 monthly visitors times 2.0% conversion times 12 months times $14 AOV].
market.regionalWedge: 3,000 annual paid submissions and $42,000 annual gross revenue [assumption: 50 niches times 250 monthly visitors times 2.0% conversion times 12 months times $14 AOV].
market.matureNiche: 24,000 annual paid submissions and $336,000 annual gross revenue [assumption: 200 niches times 500 monthly visitors times 2.0% conversion times 12 months times $14 AOV].
market.vcRead: Useful if validated, not yet a venture-scale case by itself [assumption: funding-fit judgment].

businessModel.deferred: Subscriptions, organization API access, certified mail, follow-up letters, and coalition pages [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md and MASTER_PLAN.md].
businessModel.marginPolicy: Underwrite 70% gross margin until live costs are measured [assumption: risk-adjusted policy]; prior plan claims 91% gross margin [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md as prior-plan claim].

revenueAssumptions: 24,000 annual submissions in mature wedge [assumption: market-sizing model].
costAssumptions: $2 variable cost per submission [assumption: token, email, queue, and review allowance].
sensitivityTests: Paid conversion below 1.0% breaks the SEO wedge [assumption: sensitivity test].
Variable cost above $3 per submission compresses margin [assumption: sensitivity test].
Human review above 30 minutes per day violates the operator model [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md operator constraint].

alternatives: Resistbot [assumption: category knowledge, no live lookup]
Change.org [assumption: category knowledge, no live lookup]
Quorum [assumption: category knowledge, no live lookup]
VoterVoice / FiscalNote advocacy tools [assumption: category knowledge, no live lookup]
Manual email and phone calls [assumption: substitute behavior]
Attorneys or legal aid for legal matters [assumption: substitute category]

holes: Demand may be too weak because manual outreach is free [assumption: demand risk].
Government email deliverability may fail [assumption: delivery risk].
Citation defects could create user harm or reputational damage [assumption: compliance risk].
Registry identity mismatch could make the asset unpitchable until resolved [evidence: dispatch versus source tree].
mitigations: Closed beta with paid checkout before public launch [assumption].
Human review of every beta letter before delivery [assumption].
Require operator ruling on CivicState versus Brooks History framing [assumption].
Refresh market and competitor evidence with network sources before investor publication [assumption].
residualRisks: Even validated beta demand may not imply repeatable acquisition [assumption].
Legal/compliance boundaries may require counsel and higher operating cost [assumption].
A small validated niche may still be non-venture-scale [assumption].

strategy.nearTerm: Validate business identity, paid demand, deliverability, citation quality, and operator load before adding features.
strategy.platformPosture: WrkPlug client posture is draft/operator-gated [assumption: WrkPlug Phase 0 not yet signed].
strategy.moat: Officials directory, bounce/response history, verified citation library, and opt-in campaign archive are hypotheses until volume exists [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md as hypothesis].

goToMarket.first100: 30 testers plus 20 paid submissions in closed beta, then 80 additional customers across 3 issue categories [assumption: GTM design].
channels: SEO only after successful beta and legal/privacy review [assumption]
gates: 0 critical citation defects in reviewed beta letters [assumption: quality bar].

operatorWorkflow.betaMode: Human review every beta letter before delivery [assumption: safety workflow].
operatorWorkflow.escalations: Threats, defamation risk, citation failure, deliverability failure, refunds, and official opt-out requests [evidence: moderation/compliance design].

constraints.registry: Watchlist; personal/research asset; not near-term investible BOS unless operator confirms business framing [evidence: dispatch registry note].
constraints.legal: No legal advice, legal representation, claim filing, or regulatory submissions [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md and .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md].
constraints.data: Political opinion and issue text are sensitive; Prisma schema marks key fields as encrypted at app level [evidence: packages/shared/prisma/schema.prisma].
constraints.workspace: No network research used [evidence: dispatch instruction].

metrics.citationQuality: 0 critical defects in reviewed beta letters [assumption: quality bar].

aiWorkGovernance.policy: AI output is never market evidence; it is only repo evidence when present as source/planning text [evidence: dispatch instruction].
aiWorkGovernance.citationControl: Researcher may only cite provided search results and verifies citations before downstream drafting [evidence: apps/worker/src/agents/researcher.ts].
aiWorkGovernance.disclosure: Letters include AI disclosure according to planning requirements [evidence: .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md].

unknowns: Operator business ruling [evidence: registry note requires confirmation].
Paid demand [assumption: no customer artifact found].
Live deliverability [assumption: no Postmark artifact found].
Official coverage benchmark [assumption: no benchmark artifact found].
External market and competitor research [assumption: workspace-only limitation].
